title: Watersound 254 Yacht Pond E
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Private Deeded Beach Access- Low speed vehicle- Located in a secure, gated community with on-site security- Garage- 7 adult bikes- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach service set (2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella)- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforters, laundered upon every checkout*Private Pool will be completed in early 2027*This property comes with 3 designated parking spaces. This home permits a maximum of 3 vehicles through the community security gate.DETAILS: Experience an enchanting Emerald Coast escape at 254 Yacht Pond E! Tucked within the tranquil WaterSound community, this grand Main House and Carriage House collectively accommodate 14 guests with 7 bedrooms and 6.5 bathrooms. Imagine starting the day with a leisurely stroll down the community boardwalks to the Gulf's rolling dunes, sugar-soft sand, and turquoise waters. When evening arrives, The Big Chill’s laid-back entertainment and delicious cuisine are only a quick walk or drive away! A beautiful front porch with inviting rocking chairs ushers guests into this 3-story luxury property. Step through the front French doors to find hardwood floors extending into a sprawling kitchen with gleaming quartz countertops, premium appliances, a vast center island that seats 4, and abundant natural light. Gather with loved ones for lively dinner parties or late-night games at the large formal dining table that seats 10. The spacious living area embodies coastal elegance, with French doors to the front porch, a dramatic cathedral ceiling, and exposed wooden trusses. Soft slip-covered sofas, matching armchairs, and a wall-mounted TV provide easy comfort and entertainment as guests unwind after a day of fun. Have no worries about under-packing with the convenient laundry room ready to refresh outfits and swimwear. When it’s time to retire, guests can choose between 2 lovely guest bedrooms with 2 twin beds and 1 king bed with a private bathroom, respectively.The second level features a cozy sitting space with a sectional sofa, along with 4 guest bedrooms with private bathrooms—2 of the bedrooms have 1 king bed, while the others have 2 twin beds. Up the winding staircase, a charming lookout tower with awe-inspiring views provides the perfect spot for a peaceful morning.Guests seeking privacy will love the attached Carriage House, featuring a full kitchen, living space, comfy balcony, a king bed, and a private bathroom.Indulge in a relaxing WaterSound vacation at 254 Yacht Pond E. Parking for 3 vehicles, a low-speed vehicle, and 7 complimentary adult bikes makes exploring all of 30A simple. For beach access, use any of WaterSound’s neighborhood boardwalks and follow them to the beach. Book today! SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 14):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Beds- Half BathroomSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bedroom, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bedroom, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Beds, Private Bathroom with Tub/Shower ComboTHIRD FLOOR:- Views of WaterSound and Limited Gulf ViewsATTACHED CARRIAGE HOUSE:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Living Area, Full Kitchen, Balcony with Seating*The official Google address for this home is Alys Beach, but it is advertised in Watersound due to its location within the community.*The fireplace is not for guest use.
